method: Exact source headers plus existing repository_map_metrics; analyst-annotated sufficient reference paths

bounded_allocation.explanation: Opaque individual bounds feed the joined bounds, then the final existence certificate. Balance is an additional independent prerequisite.

map_swap.explanation: The recorded path uses the first domain certificate and key equality to justify certification of the intermediate map. Inner/outer pointwise value facts are also required by the chosen reference.

clamp_distance.explanation: Per-input guarded facts: the other input is handled independently; arithmetic assertions finish the distance inequality.

prefix_split.explanation: Local unfolding only. Prove(s[1..],i-1,j) is a separate recursive contract application. Unbounded i means there is no fixed full recursion-depth number.
